notes.title: Mod Mage Mike 1.0.2 Update!
notes.content:
Hello there!

Here comes a small quality-of-life update. Enjoy!
Also don't forget to join the [url=https://discord.gg/bKw4FTbx]Discord[/url] for more updates.

Patch notes:

[list]
[*] Deactivate Spell Tower when open the Spell Editor, removing the need to double-click to shoot again
[*] Disconnect connections by dragging over them, replacing double click
[*] Highlight the help button when a new node is introduced
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Fixes update 1.0.1

Mouse can drag outside knobs when changing value
Add depth to node graphics
Bigger hitboxes on node arrow buttons
Fix toggles on nodes not turning gray when disabled
